artDirection: Half photorealistic scene, half architectural line drawing, softly blended with matching perspective. White and purple website with varied location palettes. No text or logos in assets.

assets.hero.webp: Wide solar array beside a reservoir and distant mountains, natural blue sky and water, fine purple linework fading to white on the left for headline space.
assets.home.webp: Two-storey suburban home with rooftop solar, warm peach light, photograph fading into architectural drawing.
assets.business.webp: Urban brick cafe and shopfront, amber interior lighting and slate facade, photograph fading into architectural drawing.
assets.industry.webp: Warehouse loading yard, truck, rooftop solar and generic battery cabinets, cool steel-blue palette, photograph fading into engineering linework.
assets.farm.webp: Golden fields, irrigation pump and ground solar beside a canal, distant hills, photograph fading into landscape linework.

production: Four approved scenes generated as a 2x2 image sheet, separated into four 768x512 WebP assets. Hero generated separately. No embedded webpage text. Files mirrored from public/solutions to solutions/.
claimPolicy: Illustrative concepts, not company installation photographs. Product links indicate items to explore, not certified compatible equipment bundles. No fixed savings or backup duration claims.
